answer: In this PoA design, each evaluator’s trust contribution follows an exponential temporal half-life, so reputation decays unless an identity sustains honest, reciprocal service. EigenTrust matrix factorization therefore gives freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality: lacking trusted inbound paths, coordinated endorsements cannot amplify their score or pass consensus. Legitimate interactions provide the nectar of durable trust, while the ocean-wide network’s tide of new identities is continuously discounted.
